name: Somatic Swordstrike
body:
Your mastery of two handed weapons and spellcasting culminates in a spectacular attack.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells, Weapon focus with a two handed weapon, Somatic Swordsmanship.

Benefit(s): As a full round action, you go through a sequence of martial motions, invoking the somatic elements of your spellcasting, and culminating in both delivering an attack, and completing a spell in the same round.
